Hi Iván,

I'm reaching out because you expressed interest in becoming a founding member of Swipeless.ai — a YouTube AI longform content generator.

Swipeless works differently from other content generation platforms: you connect your own Google Cloud Console account and use their $300 in free credits, so you can start a channel without risking much of your own money.

Since Swipeless is a new product, we're currently running a once-in-a-lifetime founding member offer that guarantees no platform fees, forever. You can read all the details here: https://swipeless.ai/#pricing

Feel free to also try our free Niche Finder tool — it helps you find niches with high success and earning potential by surfacing high-view, low-subscriber channels.

We are looking for a Google Ads partner who can act as a strategic extension of our team—not simply manage campaigns, but help architect the entire paid acquisition foundation. The ideal partner will guide account structure, campaign strategy, bidding approach, audience targeting, tracking requirements, and optimization frameworks while collaborating with our internal team. The goal is to create a predictable growth engine that supports both direct-to-consumer revenue and future B2B opportunities.
If this aligns well with you, I'm happy to schedule a call to discuss this further.

Hi Mattan,

I’m the Vice President of a premium fashion brand with an established retail presence across the US. We’re now entering a major digital growth phase and looking for a strategic partner to help build our full online ecosystem—from Google Ads, Meta, and social media creation to full-funnel B2C customer acquisition and B2B brand growth opportunities. We currently have no established social channels and are looking for a partner who can help shape our digital strategy, build our presence, and scale our online revenue. Our digital marketing investment is expected to be around $100K/month, and I’d love to explore if this aligns with your expertise.
